div.head: Hl 10[b]
div.ab: Gif he þonne þæt nille, gelde þonne C buton aðe, siþþan ane neaht ofer þæt gesem hie.
Gif he þonne þæt nylle, gelde þonne C buton aðe, siþþan ane neaht ofer þæt gesem[eþ] hie.
If he will not do that, let him then pay 100 without oath, after one night following their coming to arbitration.
If, however, he is not willing to do this, then he shall pay 100 shillings, without [giving] an oath, on the day after the arbitration.
Wenn er aber das [beides zu geloben] weigert, so zahle er dann 100 [Schilling] ohne [fernere Berechtigung zum] Eid, sobald eine Nacht über den Schiedsspruch [vergangen] ist.
But if he refuses that [to pledge either], then let him pay 100 [shillings] without [any further right to an] oath, as soon as one night has [passed] after the arbitration.
